developmental_stage: Freshly harvested 2-week-old seedlings were crosslinked using 1% formaldehyde and the crosslinking was quenched by 0.125 M glycine solution.
material_type: Arabidopsis seeds were cultured in plates or compost depending on the subsequent use.
sample_source: T-DNA insertion mutants, including Salk_045882 (hiz1-1), Salk_000717 (hiz1-2), Salk_120590 (hiz2-1), Salk_020625 (hiz2-2) and Salk_126486 (hiz2-3), were obtained from Nottingham Arabidopsis Stock Center (NASC) (Nottingham, UK).
species: Arabidopsis lines (ecotype Colombia-0) used include WT, m6A writer mutants and transgenic lines containing sequences encoding m6A writer proteins.
strain: Arabidopsis lines (ecotype Colombia-0) used include WT, m6A writer mutants and transgenic lines containing sequences encoding m6A writer proteins.
tissue: Freshly harvested 2-week-old seedlings were crosslinked using 1% formaldehyde and the crosslinking was quenched by 0.125 M glycine solution.
